About this journey

Explore Delhi - Agra - Delhi with a travel plan built around your interests. This suggested 1 day route is a starting point for your enquiry. Share your dates, pickup location and preferred stops with Vinod Tour and Travels to discuss transport, timing and a personalised quote.

Journey highlights

  • Explore the destinations along your chosen route.
  • Discuss sightseeing stops and time for local experiences.
  • Choose pickup and drop-off points that suit your plans.
  • Speak directly with our Kotdwara team before confirming.

Your travel arrangements

Ask for a written quote covering the vehicle, driver, route, travel dates and agreed inclusions. Confirm tolls, parking, accommodation, guides and entrance fees before booking; these are not automatically included.

Suggested route

The stops below outline the route, rather than a confirmed daily schedule. Exact timing and arrangements are agreed during your enquiry.

Stop 1 · Delhi

Start your journey in Delhi. Confirm your pickup point, arrival time and onward travel arrangements with us.

Stop 2 · Agra

Include time in Agra for the places that interest you. The sightseeing stops and time spent here can be discussed when planning your itinerary.

Stop 3 · Delhi

Continue to Delhi for the final part of your suggested route. Confirm your drop-off point and allow time for any onward connections.
